item.title: AI industry leaders call for development to slow down after recent safety concerns
item.description: After a string of security-related incidents involving AI agents and a high-profile resignation, AI industry leaders appear poised to slow down the pace of development to make sure it stays safe.
item.content:encoded: After a string of security-related incidents involving AI agents and a high-profile resignation, AI industry leaders appear poised to slow down the pace of development to make sure it stays safe.

item.title: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO's call to curb China's AI development
item.description: China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday hit back at a call from the head of Anthropic for the U.S. to curb China's artificial intelligence capabilities.

item.title: Trump downplays calls for AI slowdown
item.description: President Trump said the dire warnings about AI were exaggerated and that "negative forces" are making claims about things that won't happen. This comes after leaders in the industry called for putting the brakes on AI development.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: AI CEOs call for industry slowdown
item.description: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman are joining calls for a slowdown amid fears the AI industry is racing toward building technology that humans can't control.
